audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer phases[N].side reads 'Skill' while content win[N] and packet.levelChart both read 'Janna' for all seven rows — the page argues with itself.
audit.why: Janna's Zephyr slow, Tailwind peel, point-and-click Eye Of The Storm shield and Monsoon knockback are dedicated anti-engage tools that answer Blitzcrank's single-target hook at every stage, matching the packet's Janna-favored chart and the content layer's whys[] which already explain a Janna-favored lane throughout.
audit.corrected: Moved all seven phases[N].side to 'Janna' and rewrote each .why to state the actual anti-engage reason, matching win[N] which was already correct — no win[N] edit needed since it did not change.

audit.why: Level 6 Monsoon (130/115/100s CD) is correctly flagged as the defining spike against a single-target engage kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no digit; two bullets misgender Janna as 'his'; two Do's/Don'ts bullets paste tradeGood/tradeBad verbatim under unrelated titles (lintFindings).
audit.why: Janna's Q Howling Gale is a 14s-cooldown charge-release that knocks up and denies engage; her E shield is 16-12s; her R is 130/115/100s. Janna is she/her per champ-gender data.
audit.corrected: Added real cooldowns to breakdown.cooldowns, fixed both misgendered pronouns, rewrote the two bled bullets to match their own titles.

edits.before: The hook threat IS level 1 — their duo plays behind minions or pays immediately.
edits.after: Zephyr slow and Tailwind speed let her peel your Rocket Grab off her carry immediately.

edits.before: E joins: hook-fist is live and the lane's geometry answers to your arm.
edits.after: Her disengage still walks the target out of every hook-Power-Fist window.

edits.before: Full kit: W the flank angles — the hook from fog is the lane's scariest sentence.
edits.after: Eye Of The Storm's shield blunts your all-in burst before Power Fist finishes it.

edits.before: Zone with the arm — every minion they hide behind is tempo you taxed for free.
edits.after: Through 4-5 she out-sustains and out-spaces every engage attempt you make.

edits.before: Static Field online — the silence finishes what the fist started.
edits.after: Monsoon flings your team back mid-fight, erasing the pick you landed.

edits.before: First item: the grab chains delete and the overdrive flanks multiply.
edits.after: First item gives her Howling Gale reliable range to interrupt your engage.

edits.before: Late Blitz is one hook from winning: fish the chokes, fist the catch, and silence the channel.
edits.after: Late, her point-and-click shield and Monsoon still negate the single pick your kit depends on.

edits.before: - Janna Howling Gale: matchup-defining — The charged tornado breaks every engage — bait it before committing the dive. It writes your spacing rules. - W Overdrive is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Howling Gale (Q) is a 14s-cooldown charge-release that breaks your engage — bait it before diving. - Her E shield is down 16-12s by rank; hit the target it isn't on. - Monsoon (R) resets at 130/115/100s — pick your all-in around it, not around your own R.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Wait for her to release Howling Gale on nothing before you commit, then let your carry finish the trade.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Grabbing into a banked Zephyr slow just delivers your all-in into her cooldown-free peel.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Locket or Zeke's line, Mercs-Steelcaps by lane, then Knight's Vow paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Locket or Zeke's line, Mercs-Steelcaps by lane, then Knight's Vow paths. Add anti-heal early into her duo’s sustain.

edits.before: Commit on Howling Gale’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. His answer goes first; yours goes last.
edits.after: Commit on Howling Gale’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Her answer goes first; yours goes last.
